concepts.label: Subqueries (subquery-expr, a parenthesized SELECT usable as a SQL++ expression)

relations.subject: n1ql:subqueries
relations.evidence: A subquery in SQL++ is limited to a [SELECT](select-syntax.md) query, whereas the outermost parent query can be any DML statement such as SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or MERGE.
